machine=avocado-rzv2n-sr-som
initramfs_file=avocado-image-initramfs-rzv2n-sr-som.cpio.zst
kernel_file=Image
fdt_file=r9a09g056n48-hummingboard-iiot.dtb
fdt_overlay_1=rzv2n-hummingboard-iiot-panel-dsi-WJ70N3TYJHMNG0.dtbo
fdt_overlay_2=rzv2n-hummingboard-iiot-csi-camera-imx678.dtbo

stderr=serial
stdin=serial
stdout=serial

initrd_high=ffffffffffffffff
fdt_high=ffffffffffffffff
kernel_addr_r=0x48080000
fdt_addr_r=0x48000000
overlay_addr_1=0x49000000
overlay_addr_2=0x49100000
ramdisk_addr_r=0x4B000000
kernel_comp_addr_r=0x52000000
kernel_comp_size=0x08000000

devtype=mmc
devnum=1
bootpart=1
bootdelay=-2

load_image=load ${devtype} ${devnum}:${bootpart} ${kernel_addr_r} ${kernel_file}
load_fdt=load ${devtype} ${devnum}:${bootpart} ${fdt_addr_r} ${fdt_file}
apply_overlays=fdt addr ${fdt_addr_r}; fdt resize 0x40000; load ${devtype} ${devnum}:${bootpart} ${overlay_addr_1} ${fdt_overlay_1}; fdt apply ${overlay_addr_1}; load ${devtype} ${devnum}:${bootpart} ${overlay_addr_2} ${fdt_overlay_2}; fdt apply ${overlay_addr_2}
load_initramfs=load ${devtype} ${devnum}:${bootpart} ${ramdisk_addr_r} ${initramfs_file}
avocado_boot=booti ${kernel_addr_r} ${ramdisk_addr_r}:${filesize} ${fdt_addr_r}

bootcmd=run load_image load_fdt apply_overlays load_initramfs avocado_boot
